description: This file defines a PHP trait named EncryptionHelperTrait that provides utility methods for encryption-related functionality, specifically managing a Cryptographer instance for encryption purposes as part of the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: getCryptographer
methods.description: Returns a Cryptographer instance, initializing it if necessary, based on the existence of an encryption key.

methods.name: encryptionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if encryption is enabled by verifying the presence of a Cryptographer instance.
